name: Cel Genesis, Cry, and Sivil^3
description: The Moroccan Lounge Presents: Cel Genesis, Cry, and Sivil^3 [November 5, 2026 / Doors 9:30pm / $15 adv / $20 dos / All Ages] Cel Genesis: Oakland CA project Cel Genesis combines an aggressive mixture of hardcores and electronic themes under the guise of a dystopic megacorporation with the same name. Horrifying visuals and strobe lights assault viewers between gabber kicks and pristine sound design CRY: Cry is the new collaboration between hardcore visionary Kilbourne and mutant techno explorer Relaxer. Fusing their respective histories in punk and electronic undergrounds, Cry sees both artists sharing vocal duties, bringing a seething confrontational intensity straight to the front of the mix. They recently released AD 140, their debut EP. Across its five tracks, AD 140 takes you straight to the center of the hurricane Sivil^3 Sivil3?s music and live performance feel darkly ethereal, corporal, sharp, and melancholic.
